# Clew Labs

> Auditable AI systems, civic intelligence, and governance harnesses designed by La Shara Cordero.

Clew Labs is the independent civic technology and applied AI practice of La Shara Cordero, a court operations leader with over 10 years of public systems experience (2015–present). Clew Labs tests high-stakes AI questions through working, open-source software with deterministic boundaries, reproducible audit logs, and clear human authority.

## Executive Brief & Resume
- [One-Page Executive Resume & Systems Brief](https://clewlabs.org/resume.html): Complete one-page overview of background, systems shipped, speaking, and operating ethos.

## Core Operating Principles
- **Evidence before conclusion**: Consequential claims remain tied to primary records. Retrieval and inference are strictly separated.
- **Structure before intelligence**: Boundaries, deterministic calculations, and failure modes precede model invocation.
- **Human authority remains visible**: AI extracts, triages, and explains. AI never quietly acquires the power to decide.

## Flagship Systems
- [Verity Lex](https://verity-lex.vercel.app): A cited public record readiness surface for California superior courts. Bounded agent extracts evidence; deterministic registry calculates results.
- [Verity Lex Methods](https://verity-lex.vercel.app/methods): Formal documentation on deterministic scoring registries versus model hallucinations.
- [Agentis Lux](https://agentislux.io): A scanner and 50-site benchmark showing developers what retrieval agents experience when parsing websites.
- [Heimdall](https://github.com/earlgreyhot1701D/heimdall): Reproducible least-privilege test harness of RBAC at an AI gateway (Bifrost), featuring falsification controls and append-only audit logs.
- [Clew Directive](https://clewdirective.com): Stateless, privacy-first personalized learning path generator using verified free resources on AWS Bedrock & Amplify.
- [Themis Lex](https://themislex.org): Role-based AI readiness guidance for judicial staff evaluating workflow sensitivity.
- [Porch Light](https://github.com/earlgreyhot1701D/porch-light): Weekly plain-language synthesis of Ventura city agendas with receipts on every claim.
- [Charitas Clew](https://charitas-clew.web.app): Mobile-first public rights engine deconstructing bureaucratic notices with Gemini Flash, backed by an honest post-sprint security audit.
